messages.message: Use this FWHM fit for the detector

When checked, choosing "Use" replaces the detector's FWHM with the equation fit above. Left un-checked, the detector keeps the FWHM it already has, and this tab is just a look at what fitting the peaks would give. Checked for you when you open this tab and the detector has no FWHM of its own; a detector that already has one is never changed unless you check this yourself.
The fitted FWHM could not be applied to the detector: {1}
No FWHM equation was fit, so the detector's FWHM was left unchanged.
Load a foreground spectrum (with fitted peaks) to fit the detector's FWHM here.

Optional baseline efficiency uncertainty: a fractional (e.g. 0.05 = 5%) 1-sigma uncertainty that applies, and is fully correlated, within each energy band, and is uncorrelated between bands. The Activity/Shielding fit can fold this into its results. (A Monte-Carlo-characterized response provides its own, finer, energy-correlated uncertainty; these bands add to it.)

The measured efficiency curve this response is anchored to (imported from the detector model). Edit the reference distance, the per-point efficiencies and their uncertainties, or add/remove points. Blank uncertainty cells use the default below.
Tip: after choosing "Use", you can download this detector as an XML file or a QR code (buttons on the Detector Select dialog), or find it again later under the "Previous" tab of Detector Select.
